svg.title: Southbound architecture breakdown
svg.desc: A layered architecture diagram: an agent harness at the top, an MCP and HTTP interface boundary, the Southbound local control plane, protocol adapters, physical devices, deployment profiles, and a local safety boundary.
svg.text: SOUTHBOUND / SYSTEM ANATOMY · v0.10.0 · LOCAL FIRST
The harness plans. Southbound owns the control plane. Every device action crosses policy, audit, and read-back.
Plans, selects tools, owns session context, and decides when to stop. It never writes a device directly.
Hardware Pi is only one host.
No shell / SSH / raw device writes.
02 / INTERFACE PLANE — MCP IS TRANSPORT, NOT THE PRODUCT
05 / PHYSICAL & PROTOCOL PLANE — LOCAL NETWORK / AUTHORIZED DEVICES
lights · plugs · sensors · curtains · cameras · tags · drone
owner-authorized onboarding · high-risk confirm · audit · read-back · manual override
discovery / port fingerprint / Wi-Fi / BLE / radio evidence; no exploit attempts
06 / DEPLOYMENT PROFILES — SAME CORE, DIFFERENT HOSTS
Pi harness runs on Mac / Pi / N100.
NORTHBOUND = agent intent / tools · SOUTHBOUND = capability / policy / device execution
